item.title: ai-bindgen: I Tried This 'Cursed' Rust Proc-Macro That Lets an LLM Write Your Code at Compile Time
item.description: ai-bindgen is an experimental Rust proc-macro that calls LLM APIs at compile time to generate code. This article explores this compile-time AI tool, discusses the boundaries of Rust metaprogramming, and the right approach to AI-assisted programming
